desc:
🎫 NO TICKET? DON'T GET CAUGHT! 🚆 

🕵️ FRAUDSTERS: blend in among the passengers, complete your missions quietly, and get off at your secret station without getting fined! 
👮 CONTROLLERS: whistle, check tickets, and expose the real players hidden in the crowd. 

🚆 11 trains: Line R, RER A, RER D, Metro, Far West, Hyperloop, Orient Prestige, Lunéa, Ghost Train, Apollo Express and Nautilus Express. Vote for the next one in the lobby! 
🌦️ Rain, snow, storms, nights, and power outages 
🛍️ Guaranteed roles, outfits, gadgets, dances, wheel of fortune, and daily gifts 
📱 In-game phone: Snake, photos, and secret chat between accomplices 
🤖 Bots fill roles: play alone or with friends! 

🎮 PC • Mobile • Console 

👍 Like and ⭐ favorites to support the game!
